scripts.setup: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.mjs init
scripts.doctor: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.mjs doctor
scripts.disable: npm run build && node packages/cli/dist/cli.mjs agent uninstall
scripts.check: tsc -p packages/decisions/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --check packages/cli/src/cli.mjs && node --check packages/cli/src/agent.mjs && node --check packages/cli/src/config.mjs && node --check scripts/connect-project.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs packages/eval/*.test.mjs packages/reporting/*.test.mjs
